# Audio buses

A bus is a group of channels with its own volume and pause state. Every channel plays on the master bus, `0`, until it is put on another one, and every bus feeds another bus, up to the master bus:

```text
master (0)
├── world
│   └── cave
└── music
```

A channel is as loud as its own volume, times the volume of its bus, times the volume of every bus that bus feeds. Pausing a bus pauses the channels of the buses that feed it too, and stopping one stops them.

```blitzbasic
world = CreateAudioBus()
cave  = CreateAudioBus(world)
music = CreateAudioBus()
MusicBus music

SoundBus dripping, cave
EmitSound dripping, stalactite

; The pause menu: the world fades out and stops, the music plays on, quieter.
AudioBusVolume world, 0, 300
AudioBusVolume music, 0.5, 300
PauseAudioBus world
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), [FreeAudioBus](FreeAudioBus) | Make and free a bus. |
| [AudioBusParent](AudioBusParent), [GetAudioBusParent](GetAudioBusParent) | The bus that a bus feeds. |
| [AudioBusVolume](AudioBusVolume), [GetAudioBusVolume](GetAudioBusVolume) | Its volume, set at once or over a fade time. |
| [PauseAudioBus](PauseAudioBus), [ResumeAudioBus](ResumeAudioBus), [StopAudioBus](StopAudioBus) | All its channels at once. |
| [ChannelBus](ChannelBus), [GetChannelBus](GetChannelBus) | The bus of one channel. |
| [SoundBus](SoundBus), [MusicBus](MusicBus) | The bus that channels of a sound, or of [PlayMusic](PlayMusic), start on. |

A program that uses none of these sounds exactly as before: nothing is added to the mix until a bus command is used.
